Made with Clean, Nature’s Most Effective Ingredients

Select a product to explore the clean ingredients that power Lymphoria’s formulas.

Cleavers

A foundational herb in traditional European herbalism, Cleavers has long been used to support fluid balance and the body’s natural elimination of waste, helping reduce feelings of heaviness and puffiness.

Stillingia Root

Known as “Queen’s Root” in 19th-century Eclectic medicine, Stillingia was historically used in formulas designed to support lymphatic function, detoxification pathways, and immune system activity.

Red Clover

Traditionally used as a cleansing herb, Red Clover is rich in plant compounds studied for their role in supporting circulation, skin clarity, and the body’s natural detox processes.

Prickly Ash Bark

Used in traditional North American herbal practices, Prickly Ash Bark has been valued for supporting circulation and stimulating internal movement, helping maintain energy and overall vitality.

Frequently Asked Questions

What exactly does Lymphoria do?

It supports your body’s natural lymphatic flow, helping reduce puffiness, bloating, and water retention while promoting gentle daily detox
and balance.

How fast will I see results?

Most people notice a lighter feeling and reduced puffiness within 7–10 days of daily use. For best results, take consistently for 3–4 weeks to help your body naturally rebalance and maintain healthy flow.

How do I take it?

Take 0.5 – 1 dropper (1–2 mL) once or twice daily.
You can add it to water, juice, or tea or take it directly under the tongue.
Consistency and hydration are key to seeing results.

Will it make me pee all day like a diuretic?

No, Lymphoria isn’t a stimulant or diuretic.
It works gently with your body to support lymphatic flow and detox naturally, without over-flushing or dehydration.

Is it safe for daily use?

Yes, it’s made with pure, plant-based ingredients and is safe for everyday wellness support.
As with any supplement, consult your healthcare provider if you’re pregnant, nursing, or on medication.

Can I take it with other supplements?

Absolutely. Lymphoria pairs well with most vitamins and wellness formulas.
If you’re taking multiple tinctures, just space them by 20–30 minutes for best absorption.

Where is it made?

Lymphoria is formulated and bottled in the USA in GMP-certified facilities that follow strict quality and safety standards.

What if it doesn’t work for me?

You’re fully protected by our 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee.
If you don’t feel lighter, clearer, or more balanced, simply contact us for a full refund, no questions asked.
